title_en: Practical Examples of the Doctrine of Unity among Anthropomorphists and Assimilationists
description_en: Practical Examples of the Doctrine of Unity among Anthropomorphists and Assimilationists, from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture provides concrete examples of how anthropomorphists and assimilationists conceptualize divine unity.
